The evening took an exciting turn when her husband, Benny Blanco, bid an impressive $25,000 for a special modeling experience with Gomez’s glam team. During the event, she reaffirmed her dedication to youth mental health and introduced the Katherine Short Legacy Award, with a remarkable total of $2.

The storm brought heavy rain and strong winds, leading to widespread power outages affecting over 167,000 homes. Over 240 flights were canceled due to severe weather conditions impacting transport services. Schools and offices were closed for an extended period as a precautionary measure against the storm.

title: Haryana power cut: Homes in dark for hours, residents block roads
description: A two-day power strike in Haryana caused significant disruptions across Gurgaon and surrounding areas. Chief Minister Nayab Singh Saini assured employees that no private power distribution licenses would be permitted. Outages led to water supply disruptions and industrial production halts, impacting many residents and businesses. Appeals were made by industry bodies for urgent government intervention to restore power.

description: With security concerns arising, the Delhi Police initially refused to grant permission for Diljit Dosanjh's upcoming concert. Following constructive discussions with the organisers, improved safety protocols were established, including the addition of 1,500 personnel for crowd management. Attendees will be updated about transportation options in collaboration with cab providers. The concert is officially rescheduled for October 30 at Jawaharlal Nehru Stadium.

title: US detains Bishnoi rival Himanshu Bhau after 4-yr manhunt, India may get custody soon
description: Himanshu Bhau, a notorious gangster from north India, was recently captured by the FBI in Las Vegas. He has been wanted for a series of violent offenses, including multiple murders and extortion schemes that have plagued Delhi and Haryana. After escaping juvenile detention in 2020, he maintained his criminal operations through illegal networks.

title: 'We have to think about posting 350 first': Rauf on need for bigger totals
description: Haris Rauf said his role alongside Shaheen Afridi and Naseem Shah is to take wickets and strengthen Pakistan’s bowling attack. He stressed teamwork, middle-over breakthroughs and the need for bigger totals as ODI cricket becomes more aggressive. Rauf is also focusing on improving his pace and fitness, while backing Saim Ayub and Fakhar Zaman to contribute runs in upcoming matches.

title: IndiGo extends cancellation of Saudi flights as regional tensions escalate: Indian mission
description: IndiGo has extended the cancellation of its flights to and from Saudi Arabia as regional security concerns escalate, with Riyadh routes halted until October 31, 2026 and Jeddah, Dammam, and Madinah routes until October 27, 2026, the Indian Embassy in Riyadh said.

description: The suspect, who was arrested by police less than 20 minutes after he first started shooting, has been identified only as Kévin T, born in 1987, the National Anti-Terrorism Prosecutor's office said. Authorities did not disclose the man's last name

title: IND vs NZ 2nd T20I: Will Ishan Kishan's injury be Vaibhav Sooryavanshi's gain?
description: Ishan Kishan has been ruled out of the second T20I match against New Zealand due to a strain. The team management has added uncapped wicketkeeper-batter Kumar Kushagra as a replacement in the squad. Vaibhav Sooryavanshi may finally get an opportunity to play after being on the sidelines for nine matches. Batting coach Sitanshu Kotak emphasized the need for patience regarding Sooryavanshi's exposure to international cricket.

description: Iyer, who took over as India's T20I captain from Suryakumar Yadav in June, has scored 632 runs in 22 matches as skipper this year.

Out of 14,81,310 entries in the voter list, there are a total of 158 entries in which the names of the voters or their relatives appear strange. The strangeness of these names is due to such a mistake,” says statement released by Chief Electoral Officer, Uttar Pradesh

title: Video: Gunmen storm Jordan church during funeral, killing 7 and wounding 40
description: Jordan's government described the attackers as unknown assailants and said investigations were moving ahead at full speed. It did not immediately confirm whether any suspects had been arrested or killed. Footage aired by Jordanian state television showed two men appearing to carry pistols approaching the church and firing shots. A third man, apparently carrying a semi-automatic rifle, then approached and opened fire before all three ran towards the building.

title: Dan vs Daniel: Trump admin sues to block Alaska result if GOP candidate loses race
description: The lawsuit, filed in federal court in Alaska on Thursday, argues that the state must protect the integrity of federal elections. It asks the court to block the certification of a Peltola victory if Daniel Sullivan, a candidate from the small fishing community of Petersburg, remains on the ballot. “The United States accordingly brings this lawsuit to protect the integrity of the 2026 Senate election in Alaska,” the lawsuit says.

title: Israel launches ‘limited counterterrorism’ op after 2 IDF troops killed in West Bank
description: In a post on X, the IDF said, "In response to the shooting attack in which 2 IDF soldiers fell, and several others were wounded, the IDF along with other security forces launched a targeted & limited counterterrorism operation in the Hebron area, from which the terrorists had emerged." The military said residents in areas where its forces are operating would be allowed to leave through three designated exit points.

title: Tom Brady helped provide 750,000 meals to families in need in Tampa Bay
description: Tom Brady and Gisele Bündchen donated funds to provide 750,000 meals through Feeding Tampa Bay, supporting children, families and senior citizens in need. The contribution came shortly after the couple moved to Florida, where Brady began his career with the Tampa Bay Buccaneers after 20 seasons with the New England Patriots. Their donation helped address food insecurity and supported local families facing financial hardship, highlighting their commitment to their new community.

title: ‘A racist terror attack’: Emmanuel Macron condemns deadly shooting near Paris
description: "These people were targeted because of their skin colour or perceived religion, and for no other reason," Macron said after meeting officials and residents in Trappes. "There is no place for this in France." Macron also said the suspect's statements indicated that the attack had been planned in advance. Police arrested the suspect less than 20 minutes after the shooting began.

However, the administration will also introduce tariffs on other goods, including carpets, certain valves and waste products. The new measures will take effect on October 30. The United States and Canada have closely connected economies.

Trump had floated a similar idea earlier this year but had not raised it publicly in recent months.

With no way to escape and little hope of being rescued, he made a desperate decision to amputate his remaining foot to survive. On October 4, a large drone lifted him into the air using a harness and carried him 15km to safety.

description: PHP advised users on Oct 23 to temporarily disable its session upload progress feature until the next regular bugfix release. The warning followed an earlier advisory on Oct 21 about a related vulnerability. The latest issue affects applications only when specific session settings are changed while running and the upload progress feature remains enabled. Users who have already disabled the feature do not need to take further action.

description: Ties between the two countries had been held back by geopolitical reasons for a while, mainly Azerbaijan’s ties with Pakistan — as evident from its support for Islamabad after Op Sindoor last year — and India’s defence ties with Armenia. While Bayramov spoke about taking the relationship to a higher level, setting aside past differences, Jaishankar underlined the significance of trade and energy cooperation. Terrorism was also discussed.

The official said both sides continued to use existing diplomatic and military mechanisms to resolve outstanding issues and avoid misunderstanding and miscalculation along the LAC.

title: Northwest India turned drier, south wetter over 70 years, finds IMD study
description: In northwest India, the hot semi-arid zone grew from about a quarter of the region’s area in 1951-1980 to a third in 1991-2020, while the temperate zone shrank from about a quarter to less than a fifth, meaning that an area equal to roughly 7% of the region moved into the drier zone as temperatures rose and rainfall declined, said the study.

description: VanDyke attended the court hearing Friday and sought the release of his seized personal articles. The seven accused had earlier sought six weeks to meet their families and were allowed to stay abroad till Oct 23. They were arrested on March 13 for allegedly training the insurgent-linked groups in Myanmar.

title: Opposition's 'mock Parliament' to step up fight against SIR & CEC Gyanesh Kumar
description: Sources said a “mock” gathering depicting an assembly of MPs may take place in the national capital on Oct 28. The event will involve MPs and others, but is unlikely to be a large gathering, given that a massive show of strength to push for the CEC’s resignation is planned at Ramlila Maidan as a “Delhi chalo” rally.

title: Need to unite against divisive forces, tackle new challenges: PM Modi
description: Inaugurating the Chinmaya Amrit Mahotsav Global Sammelan, he said Swami Chinmayananda set his goals as per issues facing the country at the time and new challenges had emerged in the past few decades. “We must unite society against divisive forces. We must inspire citizens toward self-reliance, and we must connect every individual to vision of a developed India by 2047. For these objectives, we must become more proactive,” he said.

title: Centre bans reuse of single-use medical devices across hospitals
description: In a letter dated Oct 16, the Directorate General of Health Services (DGHS) said it had come to its notice that some private and corporate hospitals were reusing single-use devices after sterilising them, including items used in cardiology, nephrology, oncology, cardiothoracic and vascular surgery (CTVS), neurosurgery and other clinical services. The DGHS said that reuse could expose patients to cross-infection, device malfunction, reduced performance and other complications.

title: Brics parliamentary meet should end with joint statement: LS Speaker Om Birla
description: Talking to reporters Friday, Birla said the forum in India would work towards consensus-based dialogue on the role of Parliament in strengthening institutions, promotion of human-centred innovation in AI and digital technologies through Parliament, more representative system of global governance and role of Parliament in ensuring a sustainable and inclusive future for Brics countries.

title: Amid stir, Delhi's Jamia builds wall in front of gate; university denies connection
description: Jamia Millia Islamia is constructing a wall near Gate No. 10 amid student protests currently taking place. Students have alleged that this construction is meant to limit access to their protest site on campus. Protesters are demanding student union elections and the reversal of disciplinary actions against participating students. University officials have stated that the wall construction is part of a routine security upgrade.

title: 15-year-old girl sexually assaulted in Telangana; 7 arrested
description: Seven individuals, including three minors, were arrested in Siddipet district for allegedly assaulting a 15-year-old girl. The incident occurred on Dasara when the victim's parents were away for agricultural work. The accused reportedly took the girl to a neighboring village and returned her the following morning. The victim identified the perpetrators, leading her father to file a police complaint.

title: Tiger Shroff targeted for praising Salman Khan in 2022, shooter tells police
description: Tiger Shroff allegedly became a target of the Lawrence Bishnoi gang after praising Salman Khan publicly. During an event for 'Heropanti 2', Shroff referred to Khan as the industry's one true tiger. An arrested shooter claimed that the gang wanted revenge for Shroff's comments at the film promotion. Police are investigating the motives behind the threats aimed at Shroff and other Bollywood personalities.

title: Trump, Vance back Ramaswamy despite ad row
'Haven't seen this in a long time': Microsoft CEO on massive PHP flaw patch rush
description: Global corporations and government agencies are currently dealing with significant vulnerabilities discovered in PHP programming language. The vulnerabilities have led to millions of automated exploitation attempts shortly after the public disclosure. Leading technology executives, including Microsoft CEO Satya Nadella, have expressed concern regarding software security. In response, emergency patches were released, urging users to update immediately. As a result, many organizations temporarily suspended online operations, prioritizing security measures.

title: Opinion | 28-day challenge: We know what keeps us healthy. Why don't we do it?
Ontario farmer turned down C$16m for 164 acres; 29 acres protected for 999 years
description: Charles Stevens and his family have decided to protect Wilmot Orchards by placing a conservation easement on the property. This easement effectively restricts future development for nearly 1,000 years, ensuring continued agricultural use. Their decision counters pressures from developers seeking to convert farmland into housing. The Stevens family aims to preserve the land for future generations of farmers.

title: Jason Momoa buys Sam Neill's former 4.92-hectare NZ estate for NZ$15m
description: Jason Momoa has recently acquired a significant property in Queenstown, New Zealand for NZ$15 million. The estate, formerly owned by Sir Sam Neill, demonstrates the increasing interest in the local real estate market. Property values in the region have risen significantly, attracting overseas buyers. Momoa has deep connections to New Zealand, having visited frequently for leisure and work. He has also invested in the local film industry and nightlife scene.

title: New norms for cars from 2029: Rear-crash tests, data recorders
description: The ministry has set mandatory timelines for automakers to comply with other Automotive Industry Standards (AIS), covering occupant protection in offset frontal and lateral collisions, protection of pedestrians and other vulnerable road users, and fitment of immobilisers. The requirements will come into effect from April 2027 onwards. In a notification, the ministry also made AIS-192 mandatory for Event Data Recorders (EDRs) installed in cars from Oct 2029.

title: Giannis Antetokounmpo reportedly invested $70 million in real estate
description: Since October 2025, NBA superstar Giannis Antetokounmpo has strategically invested approximately $70 million in various real estate ventures. His family's company, Ante, has facilitated several significant purchases, including apartment complexes in Wisconsin, Brooklyn, and Chicago. Notably, he recently acquired a lavish $13.5 million mansion in Pinecrest, Florida, after joining the Miami Heat. These investments reflect Antetokounmpo's commitment to expanding his financial portfolio beyond basketball income.
